# Copilot instructions

The canonical guide for this repo is [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it
first; this file only lists always-true invariants so Copilot Chat never
breaks them.

## Stack

Python, Django, Tailwind CSS v4, `uv`, `ruff`. Do not hard-code versions;
read them from `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `.python-version` and
`docker/web.Dockerfile` once they exist.

## Non-negotiables

- `docs/spec.md` section 1 decisions are settled. Build what it says, in
  the milestone order of section 15.
- All on-screen content stays inside the content-safe area of
  `assets/background.svg`: x 96 to 1824, y 204 to 768 in the 1920x1080
  stage. Never edit the SVG.
- Copy lives in `content/*.yaml`. `docs/content.md` is generated by
  `scripts/render_content.py`; never edit it by hand.
- Every slide string exists in Hungarian (`hu`) and English (`en`).
  Hungarian is informal "te". UI chrome strings go through `gettext`.
- Prose must never contain em dashes, en dashes, ellipsis characters,
  curly quotes, non-breaking spaces or emoji. Hyphens for ranges, three
  periods for an ellipsis, straight quotes.
- Tailwind v4 syntax only (`@import "tailwindcss"`, `@theme`, `@source`).
  One source stylesheet; never commit compiled CSS.
- No new JavaScript framework, bundler, queue or storage service.
- The room never sees an error: live slides fall back to last-good data,
  then to their `empty` text.
- Nothing is fetched from the public internet at runtime: fonts, icons and
  QR codes are generated or vendored.
